subject: a fox head with a transparent optical collar
pose: head tilted slightly above a compact circular collar
art_direction: 深蓝狐形头像戴透明镜片领圈，粉橙边光与薄荷眼神形成利落中心形象，无服装或道具堆叠。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a deep-blue fox head emerging above a transparent optical collar made from two overlapping lens rings. The fox has broad graphic cheek shapes, small mint eyes, and a closed neutral mouth, appearing sharp but friendly. Tilt the head slightly and keep the ears short enough for the circular crop. A coral edge light runs along one cheek and one lens rim, while the rest stays matte. Use hard-edge illustration with only a few controlled translucent overlaps in the collar. The background is near-black indigo with no skyline or stars. Center the head and collar as one compact emblem, avoiding technical labels, circuitry clutter, or a glossy futuristic mask.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
